description: A Bot's conversation archived as a past thread of its own ("<Bot> / <its title>", read-only), and the Bot carried on in a new, empty one with a new agent: its id, name, picture, memory, tasks, browser and rules as they were. Refused while it's at a turn or one of its tasks is asking it.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.
